sourceText:
Bread Masala Roast
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 22, 2009 - 12:11am

Ingredients




8 Slices of Bread
2 mediums sized onions sliced lengthwise
4 cloves of garlic crushed
8 Curry leaves
2 green green chilles chopped
2 Tomatoes medium, choped
1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
1 dark Soy sauce
1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds
1 
teaspoon garam masala
1 
teaspoon red red chilli powder
1/2 teaspoon Freshly ground pepper
1/2 teaspoon Turmeric powder
1 
tablespoon lemon juice
1 
tablespoon Oil
2 tablespoons Coriander leaves
Salt to taste

Preparation

1 Cut The Bread Slices Into Cubes 9 Cubes Per Slice 2 In a pan heat oil. 3 Add mustard,curry leaves & cumin seeds. Let it splutter. 4 Add onions, garlic & green chilies. 5 Let the onions brown a little. Add the chopped tomatoes. 6 Keep the heat low. Add the garam masala, turmeric powder, chilli powder,Dark Soy sauce, pepper powder & salt to taste,. 7 Mix well. 8 Add Cubed Bread & mix well. 9 Leave on heat for a few minutes till the Bread brown lightly on the surface. 10 Squeeze the lemon juice over the Bread and mix. 11 Garnish with chopped corriander leaves.

About


Any Time Snack for All Age Groups
